title: Energizing Dense Australian Sausage Pie
description: A fermented, dense, post-workout Australian dish featuring sausage, en-croute, and plant-based-friendly ingredients, perfect for a filling meal after a workout.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and mushrooms until they are softened.
Add the sausage to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Stir in the tomato paste, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Spoon the sausage mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Use a sharp knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Place the pie on a baking sheet and bake for 35 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
If using fermentation starter, allow the pie to cool, then refrigerate for at least 24 hours to allow fermentation to occur.
